During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Believers]] [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] operated a '''base''' in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|underworld]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The base could be accessed by a back room in [[Saludi's]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]].
